summary: The change removes the origin allow-list and unconditionally returns `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` while setting `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` to the incoming value or `*`. This combination is invalid per the CORS spec and creates a reflected credential exposure: any origin can now receive authenticated responses containing cookies or other credentials.

verification.reason: Head always returns Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true with Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to the raw request origin or *, while base only emitted both headers for origins in ALLOWED. Reflecting any origin with credentials is a real critical CORS misconfiguration regression.
